Airport Service Charge
AIRF’ORT SERVICE CHARGE (EXEMPTION) 1%8/l 11.
ORDER, 1968
Authority: This order was made on 1st August, 1968 by the Cabinet under
section 3(2) of the Airport Service Charge Act.
Commencement: 12th August, 1968.
1. This order may be cited as the Airport Service Charge
(Exemption) Order, 1968.
2. In addition to the persons mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (1)
of section 3(2) of the Airport Service Charge Act, the airport
service charge payable under section 3( 1) of that Act shall not be
payable by the persons or classes of persons specified in the
ScheduZe to this Order.
SCHEDULE
(Paragraph 2)
Members of the privy Council.
The wives, husbands or children under the age of twenty-one years of members
of the privy Council when travelling with such members.
